description: Cape Verde Reference Power System Data is a data set deposited in DTU Data by its authors Daniel Vazquez Pombo. Author: Daniel Vázquez Pombo (dvapo@elektro.dtu.dk), ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5664-9421------------------------------------------------------------------------------- The version 2.0 of this dataset is available here - https://doi.org/10.11583/DTU.17430413 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- The first version of this dataset was presented in the paper:"The Islands of Cape Verde as a Reference System for 100 % Renewable Deployment". 2021 IEEE Green Technologies Conference. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 550498 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
